justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/Counters.java: BigIntegerCounter is a private static final nested class with one field (BigInteger value) and a small, cohesive set of 8 methods (add, get, getBigInteger, getLong, increment, reset, equals, hashCode, toString) focused only on BigInteger counting. The same file shows parallel single-purpose counter implementations (LongCounter, NoopCounter), and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/CountersEqualsAndHashCodeTest.java exercises BigIntegerCounter directly for equality/hashCode. The class is small and single-responsibility, so there is no concrete evidence of insufficient modularization.
